notes: Embedding residues into Event indices is a configured probe map, not a physical Event-space realization.
injective_pair_to_class means each modular pair lands in a unique Fixed class under the probe embedding (almost never true for large p).
fatal_for_p marks an information bottleneck: 15 classes vs p outputs with weak class→c mutual information under this embedding.
